---
title: "Workout data"
format: 
  dashboard:
    theme:
      light: [litera, ../custom.scss]
      dark: [darkly, ../custom.scss]
    scrolling: true
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
        <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;500&family=Inter:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
        <script src="/assets/cursor-tooltip.js" defer></script>
        <style>
          .year-filter-wrap {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            right: 20px;
            height: 50px;
            z-index: 15;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4rem;
          }

          .year-filter-label {
            font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: #1a1a1a;
            margin: 0;
          }

          .year-filter {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            min-width: 5rem;
            font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: #1a1a1a;
            background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #ced4da;
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
          }

          .year-filter:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #ced4da;
          }

          .year-filter-caret {
            width: 9px;
            height: 9px;
            flex: none;
            color: #555555;
            transition: transform 0.15s ease;
          }

          .year-filter.open .year-filter-caret {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
          }

          .year-filter-menu {
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(100% + 4px);
            right: 0;
            min-width: 100%;
            background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #ced4da;
            border-radius: 4px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            list-style: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 4px 0;
            max-height: 220px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            z-index: 20;
            display: none;
          }

          .year-filter.open .year-filter-menu {
            display: block;
          }

          .year-filter-menu li {
            padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
            font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: #1a1a1a;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
          }

          .year-filter-menu li:hover,
          .year-filter-menu li.active {
            background: #f2f2f2;
          }
        </style>
    nav-buttons:
      - icon: envelope
        href: mailto:teromeh@proton.me
      - icon: house-door
        href: /
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

data <- readRDS("data/workout_data.rds")

title_font <- list(family = "Outfit, sans-serif", size = 14, color = "#2D4A2B")

darken_hex <- function(hex, factor = 0.7) {
  rgb_vals <- col2rgb(hex) * factor
  out <- rgb(rgb_vals[1, ], rgb_vals[2, ], rgb_vals[3, ], maxColorValue = 255)
  names(out) <- names(hex)
  out
}

activity_counts <- data |>
  count(activity_type, name = "maara") |>
  mutate(percentage = round(maara / sum(maara) * 100, 0),
         display_label = paste0("<b>", activity_type, "<br>", percentage, "%</b>"))

distance_counts <- data |>
  count(distance_class, name = "maara") |>
  mutate(percentage = round(maara / sum(maara) * 100, 0),
         display_label = paste0("<b>", distance_class, "<br>", percentage, "%</b>"))

monthly_distance <- data |>
  mutate(month = floor_date(workout_date, "month")) |>
  group_by(month, activity_type) |>
  summarise(total_km = round(sum(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE), 0), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(month) |>
  mutate(month_label = paste0(month.abb[as.integer(format(month, "%m"))], " ", format(month, "%Y")))

years <- c("All", sort(unique(format(data$workout_date, "%Y")), decreasing = TRUE))

activity_colors <- c("Walk" = "#8FAF6B", "Run" = "#D97E3D")
activity_text_colors <- c("Walk" = "#1F3319", "Run" = "#ffffff")
activity_border_colors <- darken_hex(activity_colors)

activity_by_year <- lapply(years, function(yr) {
  d <- if (yr == "All") data else data |> filter(format(workout_date, "%Y") == yr)
  d |> count(activity_type, name = "maara") |>
    mutate(percentage = round(maara / sum(maara) * 100, 0),
           color = activity_colors[activity_type],
           border_color = activity_border_colors[activity_type],
           text_color = activity_text_colors[activity_type],
           total = sum(maara))
})

distance_colors <- c("0-5 km" = "#D9C89E", "5-10 km" = "#9CAF88", 
                      "10-15 km" = "#5C7A4A", "15+ km" = "#2D4A2B")
distance_text_colors <- c("0-5 km" = "#2D4A2B", "5-10 km" = "#1F3319", 
                           "10-15 km" = "#ffffff", "15+ km" = "#ffffff")
distance_border_colors <- darken_hex(distance_colors)

distance_by_year <- lapply(years, function(yr) {
  d <- if (yr == "All") data else data |> filter(format(workout_date, "%Y") == yr)
  average_distance <- mean(d$distance_km, na.rm = TRUE)

  d |> count(distance_class, name = "maara") |>
    mutate(percentage = round(maara / sum(maara) * 100, 0),
           color = distance_colors[distance_class],
           border_color = distance_border_colors[distance_class],
           text_color = distance_text_colors[distance_class],
           total = sum(maara),
           average_distance = average_distance)
})
```

## Row

### Column

```{r}
#| label: activity-types
initial <- activity_by_year[[1]]

activity_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(setNames(
  lapply(activity_by_year, function(d) {
    list(
      labels = I(d$activity_type),
      values = I(d$maara),
      text = I(paste0("<b>", d$percentage, "%</b>")),
      hovertext = I(paste0("<b>", d$activity_type, ": ", format(d$maara, big.mark = " ", trim = TRUE), " workouts</b>")),
      colors = I(d$color),
      border_colors = I(d$border_color),
      text_colors = I(d$text_color),
      center_text = paste0("<b>", format(d$total[1], big.mark = " "), "</b><br>workouts")
    )
  }),
  years
), auto_unbox = TRUE)

years_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(years)

plot_ly(
  labels = initial$activity_type,
  values = initial$maara,
  type = "pie",
  hole = 0.6,
  marker = list(colors = initial$color),
  text = paste0("<b>", initial$percentage, "%</b>"),
  textinfo = "text",
  textfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 16, color = initial$text_color),
  hovertext = paste0("<b>", initial$activity_type, ": ", format(initial$maara, big.mark = " ", trim = TRUE), " workouts</b>"),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = initial$color, bordercolor = initial$border_color,
                     font = list(color = initial$text_color, family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13))
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "<b>Activity Types</b>", font = title_font, x = 0),
    annotations = list(list(
      text = paste0("<b>", format(initial$total[1], big.mark = " "), "</b><br>workouts"),
      x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
      xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 16, color = "#2D4A2B")
    )),
    showlegend = TRUE,
    legend = list(
      orientation = "v",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.85,
      xanchor = "left",
      font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13),
      title = list(text = "<b>Activity</b>", font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13))
    ),
    margin = list(t = 50, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(paste0("
    function(el) {
      var dataByYear = ", activity_json, ";
      var years = ", years_json, ";
      if (el.querySelector('.year-filter-wrap')) return;
      el.style.position = 'relative';

      var wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.className = 'year-filter-wrap';

      var control = document.createElement('div');
      control.className = 'year-filter';
      control.tabIndex = 0;
      control.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      control.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
      control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

      var valueSpan = document.createElement('span');
      valueSpan.className = 'year-filter-value';
      valueSpan.textContent = years[0];

      var caret = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
      caret.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 10 6');
      caret.setAttribute('class', 'year-filter-caret');
      var path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
      path.setAttribute('d', 'M1 1l4 4 4-4');
      path.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
      path.setAttribute('stroke', 'currentColor');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.5');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-linecap', 'round');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin', 'round');
      caret.appendChild(path);

      var menu = document.createElement('ul');
      menu.className = 'year-filter-menu';
      menu.setAttribute('role', 'listbox');

      function closeMenu() {
        control.classList.remove('open');
        control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocClick);
      }
      function openMenu() {
        control.classList.add('open');
        control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        document.addEventListener('click', onDocClick);
      }
      function onDocClick(e) {
        if (!control.contains(e.target)) closeMenu();
      }

      years.forEach(function(yr, i) {
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        li.textContent = yr;
        li.setAttribute('role', 'option');
        if (i === 0) li.classList.add('active');
        li.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          valueSpan.textContent = yr;
          var items = menu.querySelectorAll('li');
          for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) items[j].classList.remove('active');
          li.classList.add('active');

          var d = dataByYear[yr];
          Plotly.restyle(el, {
            labels: [d.labels],
            values: [d.values],
            text: [d.text],
            hovertext: [d.hovertext],
            'marker.colors': [d.colors],
            'textfont.color': [d.text_colors],
            'hoverlabel.bgcolor': [d.colors],
            'hoverlabel.bordercolor': [d.border_colors],
            'hoverlabel.font.color': [d.text_colors]
          }, [0]);
          Plotly.relayout(el, { 'annotations[0].text': d.center_text });

          closeMenu();
        });
        menu.appendChild(li);
      });

      control.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (control.classList.contains('open')) closeMenu(); else openMenu();
      });
      control.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (control.classList.contains('open')) closeMenu(); else openMenu();
        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          closeMenu();
        }
      });

      control.appendChild(valueSpan);
      control.appendChild(caret);
      control.appendChild(menu);
      wrap.appendChild(control);
      el.appendChild(wrap);
    }
  "))
```

## Row

### Column

```{r}
#| label: distance-over-time
walk_data <- monthly_distance |> filter(activity_type == "Walk")
run_data <- monthly_distance |> filter(activity_type == "Run")

plot_ly() |>
  add_trace(
    data = walk_data,
    x = ~month,
    y = ~total_km,
    type = "bar",
    name = "Walk",
    marker = list(color = "#8FAF6B"),
    hovertext = ~paste0("<b>", month_label, " - Walk: ", format(total_km, big.mark = " ", trim = TRUE), " km</b>"),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#8FAF6B", bordercolor = darken_hex("#8FAF6B"),
                       font = list(color = "#1F3319", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13))
  ) |>
  add_trace(
    data = run_data,
    x = ~month,
    y = ~total_km,
    type = "bar",
    name = "Run",
    marker = list(color = "#D97E3D"),
    hovertext = ~paste0("<b>", month_label, " - Run: ", format(total_km, big.mark = " ", trim = TRUE), " km</b>"),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    hoverlabel = list(bgcolor = "#D97E3D", bordercolor = darken_hex("#D97E3D"),
                       font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13))
  ) |>
  layout(
    barmode = "stack",
    title = list(text = "<b>Distance by Month (km)</b>", font = title_font, x = 0),
    showlegend = TRUE,
    legend = list(font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13)),
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hovermode = "closest",
    xaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
                 type = "date",
                 tickformat = "%b %Y",
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12),
                 tickangle = -45),
    yaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = FALSE, showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE, tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13)),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```
